entries.h: Escapes to David from the vengeance of Saul, who slew the priests in the City of Nob
Associate high priest with Zadok in the reign of David
But called AHIMELECH and father of Abiathar
Loyal to David when Absalom rebelled; leaves Jerusalem with the ark of the covenant, but is directed by David to return
Helps David by sending his son from Jerusalem to David with secret information concerning the counsel of Ahithophel
Supports Adonijah’s pretensions to the throne
Thrust out of office by Solomon
